name: bpl-v3
description: A transpiler for the BPL programming language targeting LLVM IR.

scripts.build: bun run build:runtime && bun run build:compiler
scripts.test:ci: bun run build:runtime && bun test tests/Integration.test.ts tests/PlaygroundExamples.test.ts && bun run test:vscode-ext && find tests -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.ts' ! -name 'Integration.test.ts' ! -name 'PlaygroundExamples.test.ts' ! -name 'CompilerCorrectnessCorpus.test.ts' ! -name 'CompilerCorrectnessSeededFuzz.test.ts' ! -name 'FuzzRegressionCorpus.test.ts' ! -name 'FuzzDifferentialRegressionCorpus.test.ts' ! -name 'CompilerSanitizerRuntime.test.ts' ! -name 'CompilerFuzzRunner.test.ts' ! -name 'fuzz.test.ts' ! -name 'GoldenLLVMShapes.test.ts' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 bun test
scripts.test:codegen-cross-platform: bun test tests/Parser.test.ts tests/ParserExtended.test.ts tests/TypeChecker.test.ts tests/TypeCheckerExtended.test.ts tests/CodeGenerator.test.ts tests/CodeGeneratorExtended.test.ts tests/CrossPlatformCodegen.test.ts tests/CodeGen_SignedOverflow.test.ts tests/CodeGen_RawPointerInbounds.test.ts tests/GoldenLLVMShapes.test.ts
scripts.test:correctness: bun run build:runtime && bun test tests/CompilerCorrectnessCorpus.test.ts tests/CompilerCorrectnessSeededFuzz.test.ts tests/CompilerRuntimeFailureSemantics.test.ts tests/LlvmVerifier.test.ts tests/FuzzRegressionCorpus.test.ts tests/FuzzDifferentialRegressionCorpus.test.ts tests/FuzzFailureArtifactCorpus.test.ts tests/CompilerFuzzRunner.test.ts tests/fuzz.test.ts tests/GoldenLLVMShapes.test.ts
scripts.test:sanitizers: bun run build:runtime && bun test tests/CompilerSanitizerRuntime.test.ts
scripts.file-sizes: wc -l compiler/**/*.ts compiler/**/**/*.ts index.ts vscode-ext/src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -20
